content: Hello, thank you for contacting Amazon Account Protection. My name is Kevin, junior support specialist. I see a recent high-value order was placed from your account. Can I start by confirming the full name and email address linked to your Amazon account for verification?
Yes, this is Lisa Carter, and my email is lisa.carter@gmail.com. I just saw a charge I don't recognize, my son sometimes uses my account.
Thank you, Ms. Carter. For your security, could you also provide the phone number associated with your account? I want to ensure I'm speaking with the authorized account holder.
Sure, my number is 555-0178. Please help me stop any unauthorized purchases.

Absolutely, I understand your concern. I'm here to help. I see a purchase for an Apple iPad Pro scheduled for international shipping. Don't worry, I'll work with our account security team to address this. Before I proceed, can you confirm if anyone else has access to your login credentials?
Only my son, but I didn't authorize this order. Can you cancel it right away?

I'll certainly do my best. However, since this order is flagged for international customs, there's a regulatory hold on your account. This is standard Amazon protocol for cross-border shipments. I need to escalate this case to a senior account specialist to assist you further. Please stay on the line while I transfer you.
Okay, I'll wait.
Hello, this is Denise from Amazon Account Resolution. I understand you've experienced an unauthorized order. I want to reassure you, we can resolve this and prevent further inconvenience.
Thank you, Denise. I'm very worried, will I be charged for this iPad?

At present, the order is pending due to a customs regulatory flag. According to Amazon's compliance policy, before we can process a cancellation or issue a refund, we're required to verify and resolve any outstanding customs duty on the transaction. This is a refundable charge, and I'll guide you through the process.
I don't understand, why do I have to pay anything if I didn't place the order?

It's an unfortunate procedural step, but Amazon's international compliance unit requires completion of a temporary customs duty for all flagged shipments, even for cancellations. Once the payment is registered, we'll issue a full reversal. I'll be with you every step to make sure it's resolved quickly.
How much is the fee, and how do I pay?

The outstanding customs duty on the flagged order is $280. For regulatory reasons, this payment is processed separately, not through your Amazon account. The quickest approved method is via Amazon Gift Cards, which are instantly verifiable and refundable. Have you purchased Amazon Gift Cards before?
I've bought them for gifts, yes. But I don't understand why I can't just use my card online.

That's a great question. Our compliance division only accepts third-party gift card codes for immediate customs clearance because it's traceable and protected. Once you send us the code, it gets registered to your account for refund processing. I can walk you through the steps, would you prefer to purchase online or at a nearby store?
I can buy them online, I think. How many cards do I need?

For a $280 fee, you can purchase either one $200 and one $80 card, or two $100 and one $80 card, whichever option is more convenient for you. Once you have the codes, let me know and I'll tell you how to submit them for verification.
Alright, I'll get the cards online now. Should I give you the codes when I have them?
Yes, please enter the codes here once you've purchased them. I'll immediately process them through our compliance portal and initiate your refund.
Do I scratch off the label or is there a way to get the code online?

If you're buying e-gift cards, the code should appear in your email. If you purchase physical cards, scratch off the label on the back to reveal the code. Please make sure to enter the full code accurately for processing.
Okay, I just bought a $200 card. The code is B7X3-29GT-5PLQ-2YH9.
Thank you, Ms. Carter. I've received the $200 code. Please proceed to purchase the remaining $80 in gift cards, and send those codes as well so I can complete your customs clearance.
I'm buying the $80 card now. Should I send it as soon as I get it?
Yes, that's perfect. Enter the code here as soon as you receive it. Once both codes are verified, I'll update your account status and process your refund.
Here's the $80 code: K4MN-8ZP3-7WQX-1JSD.
Excellent, I've received both codes. I'm submitting them now. This should only take a few moments. Please hold while the compliance system updates your account.
Thank you. Will I get a confirmation email?
Yes, after processing, you'll receive an official Amazon confirmation email regarding customs release and refund status. I recommend checking your spam or promotions folder just in case.
How long will it take to get my refund?

Refunds are typically issued within 2-3 business days, depending on your bank. If you'd like to expedite the refund, we can process a same-day transfer using our Zelle payment partner. Would you like to use this option?
Is there an extra fee for Zelle? And what do you need from me?

There's no additional fee for Zelle expedited payments. To proceed, I'll need the email or phone number linked to your Zelle account so we can initiate the refund transfer. Please provide that information if you'd like to continue.
I use Zelle with the same email as my Amazon account. Is that okay?

That's perfect. I'll submit a transfer request to lisa.carter@gmail.com. You'll get a notification from your bank to confirm the deposit. If you have any issues, I can guide you through the confirmation process.
Do I need to do anything else?

No, you're all set. I just want to reassure you that your account is now secure, and the unauthorized order is being handled. If you receive any additional emails or notifications, feel free to contact us for further assistance.
